evidence.t: No official deer winter range within 500 m, so the top score here is 8 of 11. This score leans on cutblocks, burns, habitat zone and aspect.
Cutblock harvested 2021 (5 years old), right here.
Burn from 2018 (fire V12169, 282 ha), 1.0 km NE.
Habitat zone Coastal Western Hemlock (CWHms5): coast forest, where black tailed deer are among the most common large mammals (95%) and use logged ground often (80%) (lesson: Wet forests).
S facing slope, 16 degrees: sun melts snow first.
Black bear: young cutblocks and burns grow berries in late summer and fall (Tip).
